name: Sweet Tooth
description: On an epic adventure across a postapocalyptic world, a lovable boy who's part human and part deer searches for family and home with a gruff protector.

videos.title: Out of the Deep Woods
videos.overview: Growing up in a remote forest cabin with his dad, Gus learns lessons about survival and the dangers that lurk beyond the fence to the outside world.

videos.title: Sorry About All the Dead People
videos.overview: Gus follows a reluctant Big Man into the unknown. Dr. Singh discovers what it will cost to save Rani. Aimee finds a new beginning after the world ends.

videos.title: Weird Deer S**t
videos.overview: Eager to send Gus on his way, Big Man figures out how to hide him in plain sight. The Singhs attend a neighborhood party that takes an ominous turn.

videos.title: Secret Sauce
videos.overview: Gus lands under the protection of some new friends as Big Man's past catches up to him. Dr. Singh fears a nosy neighbor will unearth Rani's secret.

videos.title: What's in the Freezer?
videos.overview: Gus and Big Man pick up a traveling companion who suggests a perilous shortcut. Aimee's sanctuary comes under threat. Time's running out for the Singhs.

videos.title: Stranger Danger on a Train
videos.overview: In a moment of desperation, Dr. Singh makes a bold promise. A lost memento makes for a bumpy ride to Colorado. The Last Men close in on the Preserve.

videos.title: When Pubba Met Birdie
videos.overview: Gus's quest to find Birdie and uncover more about her connection to his father leaves him questioning everything he's ever known.

videos.title: Big Man
videos.overview: His world shaken, Gus runs off and makes a rash decision. Big Man comes to grips with long-ago mistakes. Aimee makes a last stand against General Abbot.

videos.title: In Captivity
videos.overview: Locked up in the zoo's kennels, Gus meets his fellow hybrid prisoners as he looks for a way out. General Abbot pressures Dr. Singh to produce a cure.

videos.title: Into the Deep Woods
videos.overview: An uneasy alliance forms over plans to free Gus and the other kids from captivity. Desperate for a breakthrough, Dr. Singh conducts a risky experiment.

videos.title: Chicken or Egg?
videos.overview: Gus' expedition with Dr. Singh leads to several shocking discoveries. Big Man and Aimee seek refuge and reinforcements. Becky connects with a new friend.

videos.title: Bad Man
videos.overview: As Big Man reckons with sins of the past, Gus becomes a target of anger and suspicion, Rani's misgivings multiply, and Becky begins basic training.

videos.title: What It Takes
videos.overview: General Abbot makes an example out of Gus. Dr. Singh obsesses over his research ahead of an important presentation. Becky crosses paths with a frenemy.

videos.title: How It Started, How It's Going
videos.overview: The zoo turns into a battle zone when the rescue mission takes flight, with families coming together — and falling apart — during the chaos.

videos.title: I'll Find You
videos.overview: After an eventful, obstacle-strewn journey to find a safe haven, Gus learns more about his origins and how far Birdie was willing to go to protect him.

videos.title: The Ballad of the Last Men
videos.overview: Warned about General Abbot's plans, Gus and his friends prepare to take a stand and defend the hybrid kids, no matter what it takes.

videos.title: The Beginning Is Also the End
videos.overview: Gus and his cohorts set out for Alaska to reconnect with Birdie, who's working on a cure for the Sick. But first, they test their luck at an old casino.

videos.title: Thank God I'm a Country Boy
videos.overview: After a doctor joins Gus and his crew, they seek a way to the coast and stumble upon a plane owned by a family in desperate need of medical attention.

videos.title: The Pack
videos.overview: As Gus learns more about a threat and their dangerous plans, the group races to catch a departing boat. Jepperd and Becky face an impossible decision.

videos.title: Beyond the Sea
videos.overview: An unsettling discovery at sea forces Gus to take on a grim chore as tensions swell between his companions. On land, an enemy interrogates Becky.

videos.title: The Tail-Tale Heart
videos.overview: As polar night looms, Gus and his crew arrive at the outpost — but they're not alone. To find Birdie and the cave, they must brave several obstacles.

videos.title: Here, There Be Monsters
videos.overview: After a daring rescue, Gus meets an individual well-versed in hybrid history. Amid emotional reunions and eerie revelations, all roads lead to the cave.

videos.title: The Road Ends Here
videos.overview: With loved ones beside him, Gus goes on a treacherous journey into the cave to find a cure once and for all. Meanwhile, chaos breaks out at the outpost.

videos.title: This Is a Story
videos.overview: After suffering an unimaginable loss, Gus must make a choice that will determine the fate of humans and hybrids. Who will be left to tell their story?

awards: Nominated for 1 BAFTA Award15 wins & 29 nominations total
